title: QRICH1 dictates the outcome of ER stress through transcriptional control of proteostasis
model: HT29 cells with endogenous XBP1s-GFP reporter, genome-wide knockout library, tunicamycin, FACS sort
contrast: GFP-high vs GFP-low under tunicamycin, paired by replicate (3 vs 3)
paper_calls: 51 genes at Wald FDR 0.10 in the deposited table; QRICH1 named as key effector (FDR 0.38 in that table)
barcs_calls: 91 genes at FDR 0.10 (149 against the control null)
verdict: BARCS calls the reporter pathway (ERN1, XBP1) and shares MFSD2A as top gene and 56 of the top 100 with the authors' MLE, but like their own table it does not call QRICH1 from this screen; ITPK1, CLEC12A and EXO1 are single-guide jackpots.
